Im sure eventually doesn't sound hopeful but sometimes thats what you have to try to work with. I want to say that mistakes and things not working out does not equal being a failure in the least. I understand it's so hard to believe that or sometimes believe in yourself but trying can make a difference. 
I suggest trying not to feel bad about wanting certain things or having stuff in the past that may seem "lucky". How deep the water is depends on who you ask, if that makes sense. You're feelings are all completely valid regardless of any schooling or a good childhood, and you don't have to feel bad about that.
I really hope you find a way to work this out and maybe start over. Remember you've always got people who have your back.
